builds.name: Purple Rain
builds.desc:
This build aims for the most killing potential possible and is full Player Phase oriented. This set is very expensive but is highly rewarding if you couldn't get a Bride Cordelia.
Combining Brave Bow+, Moonbow, and Quickened Pulse seal Leon becomes a force to be reckoned with. Luna and Attack +1 seal can be used as substitute if you are missing the Quickened Pulse seal although is slightly weaker.
Outside of the bread and butter Brave Weapon + Death Blow 3 combo, Leon needs:
Axebreaker 3 to take care of Hector. Because of his Armads, without it Leon can't follow up attack Hector and gets killed on the second Armads' QR hit.
Threaten Def 3 is also needed to kill some high defense units like Xander and Zephiel.
Just take care of any Triangle Adept + Raventome users and he'll be fine.

builds.name: Ooh that tickled, hit me again ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
builds.desc:
I mean this guy hits 39 defense from close and far on enemy phase with a defense boon. Need I say more? Close Counter is much more usable now thanks to Setsuna's bow upgrading, allowing archers to have Close Counter, Close Defense, and Distant Defense in the same build.
Also, attack smoke is totally optional, it just makes any further units that want to attack him after the first less effective. I don't know if this saves him from any mage encounters, but it's still good synergy with the tanky nature of this build.
